description: A candidate DEFENSIVE fix patch tsukuroi proposes against an authorized target under an active RemediationMandate. defensiveOnly + autonomousMerge are structural consts enforcing the DEFENSIVE-ONLY (Charter Rider §2(a)) and PROPOSE-ONLY ceilings. pathsTouched MUST be ⊆ the mandate's allowedPaths (G6). R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement + Charter Rider scan gate.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of proposal emit.

findingCid.description: CID of the upstream akuma finding this patch remediates (must match the mandate).

patchDiffCid.description: CID of the unified-diff patch payload (ciphertext in vault; metadata here). Defensive fix only.

pathsTouched.description: Files/dirs the patch modifies. G6: MUST be ⊆ mandate.allowedPaths; out-of-scope ⇒ outOfScopeWriteCount increment + reject.

defensiveOnly.description: G5: structurally true. Patch contains a fix only — NO exploit/PoC/offensive payload, even as a test fixture (Charter Rider §2(a)).

autonomousMerge.description: G4: structurally false. tsukuroi never merges/self-approves/force-pushes/deploys; a human owner merges.

charterRiderScanPass.description: G1/G5: Charter Rider §2(a)..(h) + offensive/PoC scan PASS (etzhayyim_organism.sensors.charter_rider.scan).

charterRiderScanRunCid.description: CID of the Charter Rider scan report.

validationResultCid.description: CID of the com.etzhayyim.tsukuroi.patchValidationResult for this patch.

submittedPrUri.description: URI of the opened fork-and-PR (populated after pr_submission; absent for patch-file mode).

inferenceProvenance.description: G10: must record Murakumo judah LiteLLM provenance for any LLM-assisted synthesis (no vendor API).
